label: source_q10
sql:
SELECT
  c.custkey,
  c.name,
  sum(l.extendedprice * (1 - l.discount)) AS revenue,
  c.acctbal,
  n.name AS nation,
  c.address,
  c.phone,
  c.comment
FROM tpch.sf2.customer AS c
JOIN tpch.sf2.orders AS o ON c.custkey = o.custkey
JOIN tpch.sf2.lineitem AS l ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey
JOIN tpch.sf2.nation AS n ON c.nationkey = n.nationkey
WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
  AND o.orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND l.returnflag = 'R'
GROUP BY c.custkey, c.name, c.acctbal, n.name, c.address, c.phone, c.comment
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

label: prepare.sql
sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lake.silver

label: prepare.sql
sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lake.silver.customer_directory WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT c.custkey, c.name, c.acctbal, n.name AS nation,
       c.address, c.phone, c.comment
FROM lake.bronze.customer c
JOIN lake.bronze.nation n ON n.nationkey = c.nationkey

label: prepare.sql
sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lake.silver.order_returns WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT o.orderkey, o.custkey, o.orderdate,
       count(*) AS returned_positions,
       sum(l.extendedprice * (1 - l.discount)) AS returned_value
FROM lake.bronze.orders o
JOIN lake.bronze.lineitem l ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey
WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
  AND o.orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND l.returnflag = 'R'
GROUP BY o.orderkey, o.custkey, o.orderdate

label: mart.sql
sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lake.gold

label: mart.sql
sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lake.gold.customer_refunds WITH (format = 'PARQUET') AS
SELECT c.custkey, c.name, sum(r.returned_value) AS revenue,
       c.acctbal, c.nation, c.address, c.phone, c.comment
FROM lake.silver.customer_directory c
JOIN lake.silver.order_returns r ON r.custkey = c.custkey
GROUP BY c.custkey, c.name, c.acctbal, c.nation, c.address, c.phone, c.comment
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 20
